newsitem.title: USA: U.S. judge to rule Friday in FDA tobacco case.
newsitem.headline: U.S. judge to rule Friday in FDA tobacco case.

text.p: U.S. District Court Judge William Osteen will rule at 1100 EDT (1500 GMT) Friday on the U.S. tobacco industry's challenge to advertising and marketing curbs put in place by federal regulators, the court said on Tuesday.

Osteen heard arguments on February 10 that the Food and Drug Administration had overstepped its authority and was violating U.S. free-speech guarantees with the new rules limiting the types of advertising tobacco companies can use.
A taped telephone message at Osteen's office in Greensboro said the rulings would be made public on Friday.
Osteen's ruling is widely expected to be appealed.

New FDA regulations require shops selling cigarettes to check identifications of young customers and limit the styles and types of tobacco advertising beyond a U.S. television ban put in place decades ago.
